title: Algarve Evolution aims to support 500 companies and help create 150 startups by 2032 in push beyond tourism
what_it_says: Report of 1 November 2026 on Algarve Evolution (Faro): 2032 targets (500 companies, 150 startups, 50,000 people), the Informa D&B study of 115 Algarve startups, 118 members, Algarve Digital Innovators, Founder2Founder, the incubator, and the INOVA ALGARVE 3.0 AI and robotics pilot for 20 tourism SMEs; quotes executive director Antonio Guerreiro.
